## Names

<a id="hitzone_up_fwd"></a>
### [`hitzone_up_fwd`](../../../src/hit_zone_tables.asm#L6) `$7200-$723A`

*data*

Pointer table $121b selects these 11 tables, $124d the 11 tables from $7489. The order is move 6, 7, $0a-$0f, $18, $11, $10.

- **Entry of:** [`move_hit_zone_facing`](../tables.md#move_hit_zone_facing)

<a id="hitzone_down_fwd_crouch"></a>
### [`hitzone_down_fwd_crouch`](../../../src/hit_zone_tables.asm#L16) `$723B-$7275`

*data*

Hit zones of move $07 (down-forward from the crouch, no fire) against an opponent that faces the attacker. One byte per target frame $00-$3a. $80 means no hit. Else $24a8 adds $80 and compares it with the distance and the reach tables $11bb/$11d4.

- **Entry of:** [`move_hit_zone_facing`](../tables.md#move_hit_zone_facing)

### [`ram_noise_after_hitzones`](../../../src/hit_zone_tables.asm#L226) `$7712-$771F`
